description: Rejuvenex Forte is a high-concentration polynucleotide (PDRN) skinbooster from PharmaResearch, the Korean maker of the Rejuran range. Salmon-derived DNA fragments are delivered by intradermal microinjection to drive regeneration, repair and skin-quality improvement rather than volumisation. It is positioned as an intensive booster for texture, elasticity and resilience.
howItWorks: Polydeoxyribonucleotide (PDRN) extracted from salmon DNA acts on the skin's own repair pathways, supporting fibroblast activity and the expression of regenerative growth factors (e.g. EGF and FGF) that promote collagen and elastin synthesis and extracellular-matrix remodelling. This regenerative, non-volumising mechanism improves firmness, texture and overall skin condition over a course of sessions.
composition: Polynucleotide sodium (PDRN) 14.06 mg per 2.5 mL ampoule, derived from salmon DNA.
usageNotes: Professional use only. Delivered by intradermal microinjection / mesotherapy (needle or MTS) and commonly combined with laser or RF protocols. Supplied as sterile 2.5 mL ampoules (6 per box). Store at 1-30 degrees C protected from sunlight; do not freeze.
features: Sterile pre-filled ampoule format for clinic use
Compatible with mesotherapy, MTS, laser and RF workflows
benefits: Positions the clinic within the well-recognised PharmaResearch/PDRN category
Versatile add-on to existing energy-device and injectable menus
Non-volumising profile suits skin-quality-focused treatment plans
Course-based protocol supports repeat-visit revenue
Ambient storage simplifies inventory handling
indications: Loss of skin elasticity and firmness

description: Rejuvenex Hydro (Hydro Essence) is a hydration-focused hybrid skinbooster from PharmaResearch, combining non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid with polynucleotide (PDRN) and supporting nutrients. Administered by mesotherapy, it targets deep moisturisation, barrier support and radiance rather than volumisation. It suits patients with dry, dull or imbalanced skin seeking a glow-and-quality treatment.
howItWorks: Non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid binds and holds water in the dermis for immediate, sustained hydration, while polynucleotide (PDRN) supports fibroblast activity and tissue regeneration for improved texture and elasticity. Added coenzymes, amino acids, vitamins and polypeptides act as a nutrient cocktail to condition the skin and enhance radiance.
composition: Hyaluronic acid (approx. 37.5 mg per 2.5 mL) plus polynucleotide sodium (PDRN), coenzymes, amino acids, vitamins and polypeptides.
usageNotes: Professional use only. Delivered by intradermal mesotherapy/microinjection to face, neck, decolletage and hands; a typical course is 3-5 sessions at 1-2 week intervals. Supplied as 2.5 mL syringes/ampoules. Store cool and protected from light; do not freeze.
features: Non-crosslinked HA for hydration without volumising
Nutrient cocktail (coenzymes, amino acids, vitamins, peptides)
Suited to face, neck, decolletage and hands
From the established PharmaResearch skinbooster range
benefits: Broadens a clinic's hydration/glow treatment menu
Multi-active formula supports a premium positioning
Course-based protocol encourages repeat bookings
Complements PDRN-only boosters for tailored plans
Recognisable manufacturer supports patient trust
indications: Early loss of elasticity and firmness
Rough or uneven texture and visible pores

description: Ailefill PN 2% is a Korean polynucleotide (PN) skinbooster supplied in a pre-filled syringe for intradermal mesotherapy. It uses purified salmon-derived DNA fragments to support skin regeneration, elasticity and tone across multiple facial and body areas. It is a regeneration-focused booster rather than a volumising filler.
howItWorks: Polynucleotide (PN) consists of long-chain DNA fragments purified from salmon, closely matching the human base composition. Once micro-injected into the dermis, PN provides a regenerative scaffold and stimulates fibroblasts, supporting collagen/elastin production, extracellular-matrix repair and improved oil-moisture balance for firmer, healthier skin.
composition: Polynucleotide (PN) 2% - 20 mg/mL - purified from salmon DNA; supplied in a 2 mL syringe.
usageNotes: Professional use only. Delivered by intradermal microinjection / mesotherapy to face, eye area, forehead, neck, hands and decollete. Supplied as one 2 mL pre-filled syringe per box. Store at room temperature (1-30 degrees C) protected from sunlight; shelf life 3 years from manufacture.
features: Suitable for multiple facial and body zones
benefits: Competitively positioned entry into the popular PN category
Multi-zone versatility maximises treatment utility
Long ambient shelf life simplifies stock management
Course-based use supports recurring appointments
Standard mesotherapy handling fits existing workflows
indications: Loss of skin elasticity and firmness

description: Save B32 is a hyaluronic-acid-based skinbooster from Bella Korea built on a dual high- and low-molecular-weight HA complex. Delivered by intradermal microinjection, it targets deep hydration, bioremodelling and improved elasticity rather than volumisation. A related SP variant adds succinic acid and copper tripeptide-1 for enhanced skin-quality support.
howItWorks: High-molecular-weight HA provides structural hydration and support in the dermis while low-molecular-weight HA hydrates the more superficial layers, together improving moisture, density and elasticity. In the SP variant, succinic acid and copper tripeptide-1 (GHK-Cu) add antioxidant and matrix-supporting activity to further condition the skin.
composition: Dual-molecular-weight non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid (approx. 40 mg high MW + 40 mg low MW; ~80 mg total per 2.5 mL). Save B32SP variant additionally contains succinic acid (24 mg) and copper tripeptide-1 (GHK-Cu).
usageNotes: Professional use only. Delivered by intradermal microinjection for bioremodelling of face, neck, decolletage and hands; a typical protocol is 2 sessions ~4 weeks apart with maintenance around every 6 months. Supplied as a 2.5 mL pre-filled syringe. Store at 2-25 degrees C protected from light; do not freeze; shelf life 24 months.
features: Dual high/low molecular weight HA complex (~80 mg / 2.5 mL)
SP variant adds succinic acid and copper peptide
benefits: HA-based option to complement PDRN/PN boosters on the menu
Dual-MW design supports both deep and surface hydration
Short 2-session protocol is easy to schedule and communicate
Bioremodelling positioning suits mature-skin patients
Upgrade path via the SP variant for premium tiers
indications: Skin dehydration and loss of density
Reduced elasticity and firmness on face, neck and hands

description: Diva Face (Lexyal Diva Face) is a polynucleotide (PN) skinbooster for the face, neck and decolletage. Salmon-derived DNA fragments are delivered by intradermal mesotherapy to stimulate regeneration, hydration and collagen support rather than volumisation. It is aimed at overall facial skin-quality rejuvenation.
howItWorks: Polynucleotide (PN) from salmon DNA provides a regenerative dermal scaffold and stimulates fibroblast migration, supporting collagen and elastin synthesis and improved moisture retention. This regenerative action refines texture, boosts hydration and improves elasticity across treated areas over a course of sessions.
composition: Polynucleotide (PN) 40 mg per 2 mL syringe, derived from salmon DNA.
usageNotes: Professional use only. Delivered by intradermal microinjection / mesotherapy to face, neck and decolletage. Supplied as a 2 mL syringe. Store protected from light per manufacturer guidance; do not freeze.
features: Formulated for face, neck and decolletage
Part of the Lexyal PN skinbooster line
benefits: Adds a full-face PN option to the skinbooster menu
Targets multiple skin-quality concerns in one product
Suited to mature patients addressing natural ageing
Course protocol supports repeat visits
Pairs with the matching Diva Eyes product for bundled protocols

description: Diva Eyes (Lexyal Diva Eyes) is a polynucleotide (PN) skinbooster formulated for the delicate under-eye area. It combines salmon-derived PN with hyaluronic acid, delivered by fine microinjection to hydrate, regenerate and improve the appearance of dark circles and fine lines rather than to volumise. It is designed for periorbital skin-quality rejuvenation.
howItWorks: Polynucleotide from salmon DNA supports fibroblast activity and collagen regeneration, strengthening thin under-eye skin, while hyaluronic acid provides hydration and improves surface quality. Together they refine texture, support elasticity and help improve the look of dark shadows and crepey fine lines around the eyes.
composition: Polynucleotide (PN) from salmon DNA combined with hyaluronic acid (periorbital formulation).
usageNotes: Professional use only. Delivered by superficial microinjection / mesotherapy to the under-eye and tear-trough area. Store protected from light per manufacturer guidance; do not freeze.
features: PN + HA formulation for periorbital skin
benefits: Dedicated under-eye option expands the eye-treatment menu
Combines hydration and regeneration in one product
Supports protocols for tired, shadowed under-eyes
Course-based use drives repeat appointments
Bundles naturally with a full-face PN booster
indications: Fine lines and crepey periorbital skin
Loss of elasticity around the eyes

description: AMI Eyes is a polynucleotide (PN) skinbooster from Korean manufacturer Quiver Medic, formulated specifically for the tear trough and under-eye area. Salmon-derived PN is delivered as a liquid by fine microinjection to regenerate thin periorbital skin and improve the look of dark circles, puffiness and fine lines. As a non-crosslinked solution it is a skin-quality booster rather than a structural filler.
howItWorks: Polynucleotide (PDRN/PN) from salmon DNA promotes restoration of the epidermis and dermis by supporting collagen and elastin production and extracellular-matrix reconstruction, aiding DNA repair and tissue regeneration. Applied to delicate under-eye skin, this thickens and revitalises the area to soften the appearance of shadows and fine lines.
composition: Polynucleotide (PN) 1% - approximately 20 mg per 2 mL - derived from salmon DNA.
usageNotes: Professional use only. Injected at 6-10 points per eye using roughly 1 mL per eye (2 mL per session), with more product placed over darker areas. Being a non-crosslinked liquid rather than a gel filler, the vascular-occlusion risk profile differs from structural fillers. Store per manufacturer guidance; do not freeze.
features: Purpose-built for tear trough and under-eye
Non-crosslinked liquid, not a structural gel
benefits: Focused periorbital product for a high-demand concern
Clear injection protocol aids consistent results
Non-volumising profile suits skin-quality goals
Complements PDRN/PN facial boosters
Course-based use supports repeat bookings
indications: Fine lines and crepey periorbital skin
Loss of elasticity around the eyes
Thin, fragile under-eye skin needing regeneration

description: Clair Eyes is a Korean polynucleotide (PN) skinbooster formulated for delicate areas such as the under-eyes, cheeks and temples. It pairs salmon-derived PN with a brightening peptide to regenerate and revitalise thin skin and improve the look of dark shadows, rather than to volumise. It is positioned as a gentle, biocompatible option for sensitive periorbital skin.
howItWorks: Polynucleotide (PN) from salmon DNA stimulates collagen and elastin production and supports extracellular-matrix restoration across the epidermis and dermis, strengthening the skin barrier. Added oligopeptide-34 supports cell turnover and helps brighten pigmentation, so the combination targets both regeneration and tone around the eyes.
composition: Polynucleotide (PN) approximately 2 mg/mL (0.2%) from salmon DNA, oligopeptide-34, sodium DNA, in a buffered saline base (sodium chloride, sodium/disodium phosphate, purified water).
usageNotes: Professional use only. Delivered by fine-needle mesotherapy to under-eyes, cheeks and temples; a typical course is 3-4 sessions 2-3 weeks apart with maintenance every 4-6 months. Store in a cool, dry place at room temperature; do not freeze.
features: PN plus oligopeptide-34 for regeneration and brightening
benefits: Competitively priced alternative in the PN eye category
Brightening peptide adds a tone-correction angle
Suits sensitive or reactive patients
Structured course supports recurring revenue
Versatile across under-eye, cheek and temple areas
indications: Fine lines and wrinkles around the eyes

description: Richesse Eyes is a polynucleotide (PN) skinbooster from Korean manufacturer JDBIO, designed for needle mesotherapy of the eye area and tear trough. Salmon-derived DNA fragments are micro-injected to regenerate and strengthen thin periorbital skin and improve elasticity and radiance, with a light filling effect rather than true volumisation. It targets under-eye skin quality and resilience.
howItWorks: Polynucleotide / sodium DNA from salmon induces tissue regeneration and enhances the self-healing capacity of damaged skin cells from the epidermis through the deep dermis. This strengthens the skin barrier and supports collagen and elastin, improving firmness, elasticity and a natural healthy glow around the eyes.
composition: Polynucleotide (sodium DNA) approximately 2 mg/mL (0.2%), derived from salmon; supplied in a 1.1 mL syringe.
usageNotes: Professional use only. Delivered by fine-needle mesotherapy to the eye area and tear trough. Supplied as a 1.1 mL pre-filled syringe. Store protected from light per manufacturer guidance; do not freeze.
features: Salmon-derived PN (sodium DNA) for the eye area
Light filling effect without structural volumising
benefits: Dedicated eye-area PN option for the menu
Barrier-strengthening, regeneration-focused positioning
Suits skin-quality-led under-eye protocols
Course-based use supports repeat appointments
Complements facial PDRN/PN boosters
indications: Fine lines and crepey periorbital skin
